reason: The README describes a plugin that lets text-only DeepSeek sessions inspect uploaded images through a view_image tool backed by configurable OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, including image description and OCR.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型提供按需查看已上传图片的能力，并通过兼容 OpenAI 的视觉接口返回图像描述和 OCR 文本。
summaries.en: Enables text-only models to inspect uploaded images on demand through a view_image tool backed by configurable OpenAI-compatible vision APIs.

capabilities: Accepts and persists image attachments for later tool access
Sends image data to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Registers a view_image tool that returns image descriptions and OCR text
